use.flag: Pull in sys-power/acpi_call for GPU power limits, the custom fan curve, GPU mode and EC sensors
Pull in app-arch/pigz, app-arch/zstd and app-crypt/age for fast and encrypted Health → Backups
Pull in the tools behind Health → System tools (dmidecode, smartmontools, nvme-cli, pciutils, usbutils, cpupower, numactl, fwupd, mokutil, memtester, vulkan-tools, mesa-progs)
Pull in app-misc/mosquitto so centurion-export can publish to an MQTT broker
Install the network guard (centurion-netguard, netguard-helper and its service) for Health → Network Protection, with net-firewall/nftables
Pull in iw, ethtool, traceroute and whois for Wi-Fi tuning and the network lookup tools
Pull in x11-drivers/nvidia-drivers for the GPU Curve page (NvAPI / NVML)
Pull in app-admin/ryzen_smu so the CPU Curve page reaches the SMU under Secure Boot / lockdown
Pull in sys-apps/lm-sensors for the sensor readout in System tools
Draw the Lighting keyboard's key legends from the active XKB layout (x11-libs/libxkbcommon)
